faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Simply browse through our professionals, select your preferred service provider, choose an available time slot, and complete the booking with secure payment. You'll receive instant confirmation.

faqs.question: Can I reschedule or cancel my appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can reschedule or cancel your booking up to 24 hours before the appointment through your dashboard. Late cancellations may incur a small fee depending on the provider’s policy.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account to book?
faqs.answer: Yes, creating an account allows you to manage bookings, view your history, save favorite professionals, and get personalized recommendations.

faqs.question: How do I pay for my appointment?
faqs.answer: All payments are handled securely through our integrated payment gateway. You can pay using credit/debit cards, PayPal, or mobile money depending on your region.

faqs.question: Are the professionals verified?
faqs.answer: Yes, every professional on our platform goes through a verification process to ensure qualifications, professionalism, and customer safety.

faqs.question: What happens if my professional cancels?
faqs.answer: In the rare event of a cancellation, you’ll be notified immediately and offered the option to reschedule with another professional or receive a full refund.

faqs.question: Can I leave a review after my appointment?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! After your session, you’ll be prompted to rate and review your experience to help others make informed choices.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: We take your privacy seriously. All personal and payment data is encrypted and stored following industry-grade security standards.
